concerns.text: The plan halts the pipeline if no dataset contains a true `permeability` column (see Phase 0 description). Because no verified open dataset currently provides experimental permeability coefficients, the core research question—whether a GNN can outperform a descriptor‑based Random Forest on permeability prediction—cannot be answered. This makes the overall methodology incapable of validating the primary claim, violating causal validity. The specification must either supply an appropriate permeability dataset or reformulate the research question to use a surrogate target with explicit bias‑control justification.
